Your work environment at ING...
ING Belgium is, as the first direct universal bank, a strong player in the Belgian market. The bank offers all clients a wide range of financial products and services via the distribution channel of their choice (click and face). ING Belgium’s clients include retail and private banking clients, small, medium and large companies.
The Sales & Services Officer is part of the local ING team focused on Midcorp and real estate clients to whom they offer simple and standard products to meet their financial needs in terms of credits and other products.
Telework according to team agreements.
